input.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, leaving both parties exposed to unlimited direct damages; we have added our standard mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. Indemnities, confidentiality and IP breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap, and our fee obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.oldText: The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000, provided that Sparkling's obligation to pay fees due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages subject to this limitation. The limitations of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to Excluded Claims, which means a party's breach of Sections 13 or 14, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
